name: The House
aliases: the old house on the corner
description: The dangerous House that the beasties and survivors inhabit.

timeline.summary: In a flashback many years ago, a family arrives at an old house; the door swings open of its own accord to welcome them.
timeline.quote: the door swung open of its own accord, as if to welcome them home

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, Marina notices the basement door standing ajar and senses that something patient waits below.
timeline.quote: That door stood ajar, revealing a thin slice of stairs descending into the darkness.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer recounts how Nashi followed his mother's voice to a carved door, sent drones through, and then went in with friends, after which the door vanished.
timeline.quote: He followed her call to a door covered in strange carvings, one that had no place in Kamigawa.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: At the door, researchers surround it; Aminatou recoils in fear and warns that it hears them.
timeline.quote: Aminatou gasped and recoiled as her eyes locked on the door.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The team takes Etrata's monitoring devices and files through the door into the House.
timeline.quote: One by one, the group filed inside.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The door slams shut behind the team as Aminatou, Etrata, Proft and Niv-Mizzet watch.
timeline.quote: Then the door closed, and the House was all.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The party moves down a dusty hallway and discovers the door they came through has vanished.
timeline.quote: The door's gone

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes the room is not the one Nashi's drone recorded, so the House rearranges itself.
timeline.quote: This isn't the same room that it recorded.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito reads the air in the parlor and concludes someone was recently there.
timeline.quote: I don't know if Nashi was here recently, but someone was

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer finds a family photo with the adults' faces scratched out and the daughter smiling.
timeline.quote: The faces of the adults had been scratched out, reduced to white scabs on the paper

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko proposes a right-hand search pattern, as in Theros labyrinth exercises, and leads the party.
timeline.quote: We take the right-hand turn and keep following to the right until and unless we wind up back where we started.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The party finds an abandoned funfair in a cornfield beyond glass doors, but Zimone shows the sky is a glass ceiling, so it is still the House.
timeline.quote: If they were indoors, there could be no breeze, and without a breeze, why was it moving?

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer refuses Kaito's idea of scouting the rooftops, insisting the group stay visible to one another.
timeline.quote: You were the one who realized we had to stay ever visible to one another.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer says the House feels like a shell encasing all that remained of the plane, and decides they should return to where the door vanished.
timeline.quote: This feels like a shell surrounding everything there is of what once was, and I fear it has no limits.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A voice cries for help and Tyvar runs toward it; Zimone chases him.
timeline.quote: Tyvar's thin leash on his own heroic urges snapped, and he took off running

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone races after Tyvar through the doorway as something shatters beside her head and the ballroom disappears.
timeline.quote: Something shattered on the doorway next to her head as she ran through

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone find an empty hall with no one in danger and conclude the House is playing tricks.
timeline.quote: On the other side of the door was an empty hall.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The doorway behind Tyvar and Zimone becomes a solid wall papered with moths, separating them from the others.
timeline.quote: where the doorway back to the ballroom should have been, was a wall

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Niko realize the doorway moved and skewed Niko's aim, so the trap was deliberate.
timeline.quote: The doorway moved as Tyvar passed through it.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito steps toward the doorway and the floor opens into a toothed mouth; he falls into blackness as the Wanderer fails to catch him.
timeline.quote: The floor he stepped onto opened like the mouth of a lamprey

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko holds the Wanderer back from jumping after Kaito, and the hole disappears.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer tensed as if to jump after him, only to stop when Niko grabbed her wrist.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone discover their hallway has turned into a towering library when they stopped looking.
timeline.quote: They were no longer in a hallway.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar turns his skin to wood and punches through the wall, finding a stairway beyond.
timeline.quote: Tyvar's skin rippled, taking on the hardwood sheen of the floor beneath his feet

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone ties a fractal thread to Tyvar and stays in the library to study the books while he climbs the stairs.
timeline.quote: I'll keep the other one, and hopefully that means we won't lose each other.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar climbs a stairwell lined with portraits of people distorted into monstrous shapes.
timeline.quote: The walls of the stairwell were decorated with painted portraits of ordinary people

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar's climb leads back into the same library, where Zimone waits.
timeline.quote: He was back in the library.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Niko she killed Nashi's mother in the invasion; Niko argues Phyrexia is to blame.
timeline.quote: I was sorry to kill her.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko and the Wanderer enter a freezing meat locker with hanging carcasses.
timeline.quote: heavy iron chains hanging from the ceiling, the hooks at their ends driven into massive cuts of meat

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A stranger yanks Niko and the Wanderer behind a hanging carcass, just before a masked figure appears.
timeline.quote: yanked them hard behind the nearest hanging, flensed behemoth

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A tall razorkin with a cleaver stalks through the carcasses toward them.
timeline.quote: a figure came stalking through the carcasses, tall and wiry.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter lures the razorkin into a beartrap by rattling a chain and leads Niko and the Wanderer out.
timeline.quote: only to step into a beartrap that had been concealed by the fog on the floor.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter explains razorkin from the Floodpits track sound and that fighting one head-on would lose.
timeline.quote: The ones you find in the Floodpits aren't used to hearing sounds not echoed through water.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter tells them he has lived in the House most of his life and that the House is the whole world.
timeline.quote: The House is the world, and the world is the House, and once it has hold of you, there's nowhere else to go.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth, imprisoned in a house, expands its barriers and swallows the entire plane in the Ascension, folding the demon realm into the physical realm.
timeline.quote: expanded the barriers of the House and swallowed the entire plane in a period of chaos known as the Ascension

citation.work: Duskmourn
citation.text: "Duskmourn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Rotrue Wood is the last wilderness to fall to the House.
timeline.quote: The Rotrue Wood was the last to fall.

citation.work: Duskmourn
citation.text: "Duskmourn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The House begins to prey on citizens' fears, and a twisted symbiosis with its victims develops.
timeline.quote: As the house began to expand, it started to prey on its citizens and their fears.

citation.work: Duskmourn
citation.text: "Duskmourn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Phyrexians fail to enter the House, possibly blocked by Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , the Phyrexians failed to enter the House.

citation.work: Duskmourn
citation.text: "Duskmourn", section "Omenpath era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Omenpath Era, doors to other planes become easier for Valgavoth to open, and the House shifts from farming to hunting.
timeline.quote: It can now hunt rather than farm, and the safe zones are rapidly decreasing.

citation.work: Duskmourn
citation.text: "Duskmourn", section "Omenpath era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The carnival grounds safe zone is lost to City's razorkin and Wickerfolk around 4564 AR.
timeline.quote: It was lost to City 's razorkin and Wickerfolk around 4564 AR .

citation.work: Duskmourn
citation.text: "Duskmourn", section "Safe zones". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Lord of Pain injects a cellarspawn's essence seeking unparalleled agony; instead his mind is flung into the House's screens.
timeline.quote: it wrenched his mind from his body and flung it into the screens of the House

citation.work: Lord of Pain
citation.text: "Lord of Pain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Watching a survivor's death through a screen, he abandons his mortal body to live in the screens.
timeline.quote: he gleefully abandoned his mortal body to live exclusively within the House's screens

citation.work: Lord of Pain
citation.text: "Lord of Pain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Spindlewight finds three survivors in a ruined library and defends them from a cellarspawn; the dying parent entrusts him with the children.
timeline.quote: In a ruined library, he discovered three survivors

citation.work: Spindlewight
citation.text: "Spindlewight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Spindlewight learns his people's purpose is to protect survivors and brings it back to the beasties.
timeline.quote: This encounter revealed his people's purpose: to protect and cherish the survivors

citation.work: Spindlewight
citation.text: "Spindlewight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A keep-alive flees when Spindlewight's mask falls; he steps down from leadership.
timeline.quote: removed himself from beastie leadership

citation.work: Spindlewight
citation.text: "Spindlewight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Spindlewight dies, and only his mask is returned by the survivor.
timeline.quote: with only Spindlewight's mask returned by the survivor

citation.work: Spindlewight
citation.text: "Spindlewight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Niv-Mizzet guards the door and controls access to it.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

relations.note: Has lived there most of his life.
relations.quote: And how long have you lived in the House, Winter?

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

pages_say.description: A run-down house with strange angles reached through a door that appears on Ravnica; it is where Nashi disappeared.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

pages_say.description: A shifting, rotting house that rearranges itself when unobserved, plays tricks and, per Winter, is the world.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

pages_say.description: A once-ordinary dwelling owned by the Vendrell family that now spans the whole plane as a living entity thriving on fear.

citation.work: Duskmourn
citation.text: "Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: The sentient house of Duskmourn with screens throughout.

citation.work: Lord of Pain
citation.text: "Lord of Pain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: The dangerous House that the beasties and survivors inhabit.
